specs.Picture Quality Enhancement Technology: sRGB 99%, VESA DisplayHDR 400, 1ms MBR, Colour calibrated, Eye Comfort Features

features: Display: UltraWide 34 in (86.36 cm), IPS panel (2560 x 1080), 21:9 aspect ratio, with brightness levels of 400cd/m2, a contrast ratio 1000:1 , wide 178o(R/L), 178o(U/D) viewing angles, making it suitable for both work and entertainment.

100Hz Refresh Rate & 5ms Response: With a 100Hz refresh rate and a 5ms response time, the monitor delivers smooth, fluid visuals, Fast-paced content such as gaming or video playback remains responsive and free from distracting motion blur.

HDR10 & HDR Effect: HDR10 support for enhanced contrast and brightness, HDR Effect mode for vivid, lifelike visuals, The anti-glare surface ensures comfortable viewing in different lighting conditions.

Professional Color Accuracy: sRGB 99% (CIE1931) Color Gamut, 8bit (6bit+FRC) Color, 16.7M Color Depth, Multiple Picture Mode SDR:Custom / VIVID / HDR Effec /Reader mode/ Cinema/ FPS/ RTS/ Color Weakness.

Eye-Care Features: To reduce eye strain during long sessions, the monitor integrates Flicker Safe, Reader Mode, Color Weakness, Super Resolution+, these features make extended use more comfortable and healthier for the eyes.

Gaming Enhancements: Gamers benefit from Dynamic Action which eliminates screen tearing, Crosshair, Black Stabilizer, further enhance gameplay by improving clarity, responsiveness, and visibility in dark scenes.

Versatile Connectivity: The monitor offers flexible connections with HDMI 1 (HDCP 2.2, VRR 56 - 100Hz), 1 DisplayPort (HDCP 2.2), 3-pole headphone out, This makes it easy to connect PCs, consoles, and audio devices.

Smart Convenience: Convenience is built in with Auto Input Switch, which automatically detects active connections, Smart Energy Saving, available in 18 languages, allows easy customization of settings

Design & Ergonomics: 3-side virtually borderless design that maximizes screen space, It also supports tilt adjustment from -5° to 15°, ensuring comfortable viewing angles for productivity and entertainment.
Energy Efficient: 36W ERP typical power consumption, <0.5W sleep mode, <0.3W DC off.
